windows_exact_package.failure: tool receipt did not become superseded

coordinator_action.stderr: agentconductor: lease is held: another owner holds the lock (...\run\coordinator.lock)

root_cause: The active agent-room worker holds coordinator.lock. ToolRefresh fell through to a separate ui-action process, whose normal tool_refresh path requires the same lease and exited without changing the receipt.
fix: Atomically enqueue a bounded refresh request and have the current coordinator process it while holding its existing lease. The coordinator advances and persists approval_epoch, re-verifies the workspace, and atomically supersedes the old receipt while creating a new pending receipt. Stale queue requests are rejected and epoch changes are rolled back when the old decision already changed.
